title: The Builder-Critic Loop
subtitle: How electric-forest turns a builder's claim into evidence a hostile critic can't refute
throughline: one task through the loop — a builder's claim, a deterministic recording, and a fresh critic session that must fail to refute it

chapters.title: A Claim Is Not Evidence
chapters.blurb: electric-forest's one rule: a satisfied builder makes a claim, a recording is evidence, and a critic must fail to refute it.

steps.title: A Claim Is Not Evidence
steps.coverSubtitle: A satisfied builder makes a claim; a recording is evidence
steps.spoken: Electric forest runs on one rule: a builder's satisfaction is a claim, a recording is evidence, and a separate critic must fail to refute it.
steps.displayNarration: `AGENTS.md` opens with one rule: a builder being satisfied is a **claim**, a deterministic recording of the run is **evidence**, and a hostile **critic** session must interrogate it and fail to refute it.

steps.title: A satisfied builder
steps.spoken: A builder that is satisfied with its own work has produced a claim, and nothing more.
steps.displayNarration: A builder satisfied with its own work has produced a **claim** — nothing more.

steps.title: The recording is evidence
steps.spoken: The evidence is a deterministic recording of the run, one you can interrogate in full.
steps.displayNarration: **Evidence** is a deterministic recording of the run — interrogable, in full.

steps.title: A fresh critic session
steps.spoken: A fresh critic session interrogates that recording. It never trusts the builder, and it never fixes the code.
steps.displayNarration: A fresh **critic** session interrogates the recording. It never trusts, and it never fixes.

steps.title: Two attack directions
steps.spoken: It attacks two ways: falsification, finding one point that contradicts the claim; and sufficiency, finding changed code the evidence never exercised.
steps.displayNarration: **Falsify**: one contradicting point. **Sufficiency**: changed code the evidence never ran.

steps.title: Only the critic verifies
steps.spoken: The task moves from pending, to in progress, to implemented, to verified. Only the critic is allowed to set verified.
steps.displayNarration: `pending → in-progress → implemented → verified` — only the critic sets **verified**.

steps.title: The queue regenerates
steps.spoken: On every status change, build queue dot p y regenerates the queue file, and the change is committed.
steps.displayNarration: Every status change: `build_queue.py` regenerates `QUEUE.md`, then commit.

steps.title: The loud stop
steps.spoken: The project itself can be building, complete, paused, or an invalid loop, a loud stop that hands control back to a human.
steps.displayNarration: `.eforest/project.json`: `building · complete · paused · invalid_loop` — the loud stop for a human.

chapters.title: The Builder's Gauntlet
chapters.blurb: The Builder protocol on one task: read the attack list, clear the gates in ascending cost, then write the claim.

steps.title: The Builder's Gauntlet
steps.coverSubtitle: One task, from the top of the queue to a claim
steps.spoken: The builder's protocol, played out on one task, from the top of the queue to a claim the critic will attack.
steps.displayNarration: The **Builder** protocol on one task: take the top of `QUEUE.md`, clear the gates, prove any browser work, and write the claim.

steps.title: Read the attack list
steps.spoken: Read the whole task readme first. Its attack list tells you exactly how you will be judged.
steps.displayNarration: Read the whole task `readme.md` first — the **attack list** says how you will be judged.

steps.title: Gates in ascending cost
steps.spoken: Run the gates in ascending cost: format and lint, then typecheck, then tests, then build. Any failure sends you back to the top.
steps.displayNarration: Gates in ascending cost: `fmt+lint → typecheck → tests → build`. Fail sends you back to the top.

steps.title: Scratch is not evidence
steps.spoken: You may self validate without limit inside the work folder, but none of that counts as evidence.
steps.displayNarration: Self-validate without limit in the gitignored `work/` folder — **none of it is evidence**.

steps.title: Record browser work
steps.spoken: If the change reaches the browser, Playwright drives it while Replay Chromium records the run.
steps.displayNarration: Browser-reaching change? **Playwright** drives it; **Replay Chromium** records the run.

steps.title: Two artifacts, one session
steps.spoken: One session yields two artifacts: a verified MP4 and the uploaded Replay recording.
steps.displayNarration: One session, two artifacts: a verified **MP4** and the uploaded **Replay recording**.

steps.title: Write the claim
steps.spoken: Then you write the claim: the commit, the commands, the evidence paths, and the Replay URL. Silence is forbidden.
steps.displayNarration: The claim: commit, commands, evidence paths, Replay URL — **silence is forbidden**.

steps.title: Now it waits
steps.spoken: Status flips to implemented. The queue is rebuilt and committed, and now it waits for the critic.
steps.displayNarration: `status: implemented`. Queue rebuilt, committed — now it **waits for the critic**.

chapters.title: The Critic Attacks
chapters.blurb: The Critic charter as one attack run: predict first, interrogate the recording, then try everything to refute the claim.

steps.title: The Critic Attacks
steps.coverSubtitle: Predict, interrogate the recording, try everything to refute
steps.spoken: The critic charter as one attack run: predict, interrogate the recording, and try everything to refute the claim.
steps.displayNarration: The **Critic** charter as one attack run: a fresh session orients, predicts, interrogates the recording, and issues a cited verdict.

steps.title: Orient first
steps.spoken: A fresh session receives the readme, the diff, and the evidence. Orient before touching anything.
steps.displayNarration: A fresh session gets the `readme`, the `diff`, and the `evidence`. **Orient first.**

steps.title: Predict before looking
steps.spoken: Write the falsifiable prediction before you look. Otherwise it is just a caption on whatever you find.
steps.displayNarration: Write the **falsifiable prediction** BEFORE looking — else it is just a caption.

steps.title: Interrogate the recording
steps.spoken: Never re-drive the app. Interrogate the builder's recorded session through the Replay MCP.
steps.displayNarration: Never re-drive the app: interrogate the recorded session through the **Replay MCP**.

steps.title: Hold every hunk
steps.spoken: Coverage: every changed hunk must be executed, marked needs evidence, shown dead, or explicitly waived.
steps.displayNarration: Coverage: every changed hunk is `executed`, `needs-evidence`, `dead`, or `waived`.

steps.title: Sabotage the impl
steps.spoken: Cold clone the acceptance run, then sabotage the implementation. The tests must go red.
steps.displayNarration: Cold-clone the acceptance run; **sabotage the impl** — tests must go red.

steps.title: A cited verdict
steps.spoken: The verdict is refuted, and every finding cites a point anyone can jump straight to.
steps.displayNarration: `VERDICT: refuted` — and every finding **cites a point** anyone can jump to.

steps.title: Promote what survives
steps.spoken: Whatever survives gets promoted: a test, a golden log, a set of fuzz seeds.
steps.displayNarration: What survives gets **promoted**: a test, a golden log, fuzz seeds.

chapters.title: The Loop That Compounds
chapters.blurb: Zoom out from one task to the machine: two layers of time travel, a runnable doctrine, and a loop that runs on the product.

steps.title: The Loop That Compounds
steps.coverSubtitle: The doctrine, runnable — and pointed at the product itself
steps.spoken: Zoom out from one task to the machine, and the whole doctrine becomes a loop that compounds.
steps.displayNarration: Zoom out from one task to the machine: evidence is time travel, the doctrine is runnable, and every verified task makes the next one harder to fake.

steps.title: Two layers of time travel
steps.spoken: Evidence has two layers of time travel: the Replay recording, and the stream's own event log.
steps.displayNarration: Two layers of time travel: the **Replay recording**, and the stream's own **event log**.

steps.title: Bisect the divergence
steps.spoken: Digest bisect binary searches for the first offset where two logs diverge.
steps.displayNarration: **Digest bisect** binary-searches the first offset where two logs diverge.

steps.title: The doctrine, runnable
steps.spoken: work queue dot j s composes implement task and verify task. The doctrine, made runnable.
steps.displayNarration: `work-queue.js` composes `implement-task` and `verify-task` — the doctrine, runnable.

steps.title: Rework, then thrash
steps.spoken: Refuted means rework with the report, at most twice. Identical findings mean thrash.
steps.displayNarration: Refuted → **rework** with the report, twice at most. Identical findings = thrash.

steps.title: invalid_loop
steps.spoken: Invalid loop records the reason, commits it, and a human takes over.
steps.displayNarration: `invalid_loop`: reason recorded, committed — **a human takes over**.

steps.title: It compounds
steps.spoken: Every verified task makes the gauntlet stricter. The loop runs on the very product it is building.
steps.displayNarration: Every verified task makes the gauntlet **stricter**. The loop runs on the product.
